verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a SaaS product with a public REST API, OAuth, an MCP integration and a CLI, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair thing to ask for. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, developer test account or isolated non-production environment. The free single-project plan is at most a user-side workaround, not a sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
